mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 59 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park. We also have a clear view of the ISS tonight at 8:30 PM as it travels from the northwest over Verona High School toward Fitchburg, appearing halfway up the sky.

The Verona Police Department is looking for new officers to join their team, offering specialized assignments like the K9 unit and drone team. Also, remember to take advantage of the free e-waste drop-off event at the Recycling Center on October 17 from 8 AM to 3 PM.
There is plenty to do with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia happening today. Tomorrow, enjoy the downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday Pizza at Lake Lou-ee.
On September 5, Verona police officers investigated a strange incident where multiple vehicles were found with cheese slices on their windshields due to a viral social media trend.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a remodel, so be sure to check back for updates on when they will be serving their famous custard again.
